lessons.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
lessons.title_zh: COP31未達成重大氣候協議，談話暴露出嚴重分歧

paragraphs.en: The United Nations COP31 climate conference in Turkey has concluded without a major new agreement after fierce debates over money and fossil fuels. Negotiations ran longer than planned as delegates searched for common ground, making this gathering the longest UN climate meeting in history. However, the final text proved unacceptable to the European Union and Pacific island nations because it omitted any direct mention of fossil fuels.
paragraphs.zh: 在針對資金與化石燃料展開激烈辯論後，土耳其的聯合國第31屆氣候變遷綱要公約締約方大會（COP31）在未達成重大新協議的情況下閉幕。隨著代表們尋找共識，談判時間比預期更長，這使本次會議成為聯合國歷史上最長的氣候會議。然而，最終文本對歐盟和太平洋島國而言是無法接受的，因為它省略了對化石燃料的任何直接提及。

paragraphs.en: Many poorer nations also expressed frustration regarding the lack of clear financial promises from wealthier countries to help them manage rising temperatures. This marks the first major collapse of a political agreement at a COP since 2009 in Copenhagen. UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres stated that he was deeply disappointed with the outcome. Meanwhile, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese blamed the breakdown on difficult geopolitical times.
paragraphs.zh: 許多較貧窮的國家也對富裕國家缺乏明確的財務承諾以協助其應對氣溫上升表達了不滿。這是自2009年哥本哈根會議以來，COP政治協議首次發生重大破裂。聯合國祕書長古特瑞斯（Antonio Guterres）表示，他對這個結果感到深深的失望。同時，澳洲總理艾班尼斯（Anthony Albanese）將破局歸咎於艱難的地緣政治時期。

paragraphs.en: During the final days of the talks, a draft deal was presented to exhausted delegates, but the words fossil fuels were completely missing from the text. The European Union strongly objected to the absence, with Irish Minister Darragh O'Brien calling it unconscionable. Conversely, oil-producing nations defended their positions. Saudi Arabia argued that Arab countries account for only a small proportion of historical greenhouse gas emissions, while Russia warned that moving away from energy sources too quickly could cause severe fuel poverty.
paragraphs.zh: 在談判的最後幾天，一份協定草案被提交給筋疲力盡的代表們，但「化石燃料」這個詞在文本中完全消失了。歐盟強烈反對這種缺失，愛爾蘭部長達拉·歐布萊恩（Darragh O'Brien）稱其為不可理喻。相反地，產油國則為自己的立場辯護。沙烏地阿拉伯主張，阿拉伯國家在歷史溫室氣體排放量中僅占極小比例，而俄羅斯則警告說，過快放棄能源來源可能會導致嚴重的燃料貧窮。

paragraphs.en: Another major obstacle in the discussions was the provision of money for developing nations to adapt to intense heatwaves and droughts. Last year, countries agreed to triple such financial support, but the current deal contained no specific figures or baseline measurements, leading to fears that rich nations would have too much flexibility. Although the main agreement failed, participants still made progress on a just transition mechanism to support workers shifting toward clean energy.
paragraphs.zh: 討論中的另一大障礙是為開發中國家提供適應劇烈熱浪和乾旱的資金。去年，各國同意將此類財政支援增加三倍，但目前的協議未包含具體數字或基準測量，引發了人們對富裕國家將擁有過多彈性的擔憂。儘管主要協議宣告失敗，與會者仍在支援勞工轉向乾淨能源的正義轉型機制上取得了進展。

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞 making 引導的子句，表示前面整句情況所產生的結果。
grammar.example: Negotiations ran longer than planned as delegates searched for common ground, making this gathering the longest UN climate meeting in history.
grammar.focus: making this gathering the longest UN climate meeting in history

lessons.title: Why does your body store fat in your butt?
lessons.title_zh: 為什麼你的身體會把脂肪儲存在臀部？

paragraphs.en: Have you ever wondered why parts of your body, like your elbows, are firm while your butt is soft? This difference comes from fat distribution. Fat, or adipose tissue, is not just stored energy; it also protects our internal organs and regulates hormones. White fat stores energy and keeps us warm under the skin, while brown fat contains many mitochondria that generate heat to warm the body when we get cold.
paragraphs.zh: 你是否曾好奇過，為什麼身體有些部位（如手肘）很結實，而臀部等其他部位卻比較鬆軟？這種差異來自於脂肪分佈。脂肪（或稱脂肪組織）不僅僅是儲存的能量；它還能保護我們的內臟器官並調節荷爾蒙。白色脂肪能儲存能量並在皮膚下保暖，而棕色脂肪則含有大量的粒線體，能在我們感到寒冷時產生熱量來為身體加溫。

paragraphs.en: Three main factors determine where white fat gathers: genetics, hormones, and age. For example, the hormone estrogen often directs fat to accumulate in the butt, thighs, and arms. In contrast, cortisol, which is related to stress, directs fat toward the belly. Furthermore, our bodies avoid storing fat near joints like elbows or around the head, where it could limit movement or cause the brain to overheat. Therefore, areas like the butt and thighs are safer places for storage.
paragraphs.zh: 有三個主要因素決定白色脂肪聚集的位置：基因、荷爾蒙和年齡。例如，雌激素這種荷爾蒙通常會引導脂肪堆積在臀部、大腿和手臂。相反地，與壓力相關的皮質醇則會將脂肪導向腹部。此外，我們的身體會避免在手肘等關節附近或頭部周圍儲存脂肪，因為這可能會限制活動或導致大腦過熱。因此，臀部和大腿等部位是較安全的儲存場所。

paragraphs.en: Interestingly, humans carry far more fat than most other mammals. Even a hippopotamus only has about two percent body fat, while an average human woman has over thirty percent. Outside of hibernating bears or marine mammals like whales, few animals store this much fat. Anthropologists believe our ancestors developed this trait as a food insurance policy. Because they could not always rely on hunting and gathering, extra body fat helped early humans survive when food became scarce.
paragraphs.zh: 有趣的是，人類身上的脂肪遠多於大多數其他哺乳動物。即使是河馬，其體脂肪率也只有大約百分之二，而一般人類女性的體脂肪率則超過百分之三十。除了冬眠的熊或像鯨魚這樣的海洋哺乳動物之外，很少有動物會儲存這麼多脂肪。人類學家認為，我們的祖先發展出這種特徵是作為一種食物保險機制。因為他們無法總是依靠狩獵和採集，多餘的體脂肪能幫助早期人類在食物變得短缺時存活下來。

paragraphs.en: Ancient art supports this evolutionary theory. Small stone figures known as Gravettian statues, created between 25,000 and 28,000 years ago across Europe and Russia, show feminine figures with significant body fat. These realistic sculptures suggest that ancient people actually carried extra fat to endure freezing winters. Thus, storing fat in your butt is an ancient survival adaptation that still protects our bodies today.
paragraphs.zh: 古代藝術為這項演化理論提供了支持。被稱為格拉維特雕像的小型石雕於兩萬五千至兩萬八千年前在歐洲和俄羅斯各地被創作出來，描繪了具有大量體脂肪的女性形象。這些寫實的雕塑表明，古代人確實帶有額外的脂肪以度過嚴寒的冬天。因此，將脂肪儲存在臀部是一種古老的生存適應機制，至今仍在保護著我們的身體。

grammar.explain: 疑問詞 why 引導名詞子句，在主要子句中作為及物動詞 wondered 的受詞。
grammar.example: Have you ever wondered why parts of your body, like your elbows, are firm while your butt is soft?
grammar.focus: why parts of your body, like your elbows, are firm while your butt is soft

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 which 引導非限定關係子句，置於逗號後，補充說明前面的先行詞 cortisol。
grammar.example: In contrast, cortisol, which is related to stress, directs fat toward the belly.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to endure 形成的不定詞片語，用來說明古人身上帶有額外脂肪的目的。
grammar.example: These realistic sculptures suggest that ancient people actually carried extra fat to endure freezing winters.

lessons.title: Spacecraft reaches Mercury on second-ever mission to enter its orbit
lessons.title_zh: 太空船抵達水星 展開史上第二次進入其軌道的任務

paragraphs.en: After traveling for over eight years and six billion miles, a joint European-Japanese spacecraft has finally arrived at Mercury. The mission, named BepiColombo, is preparing to enter orbit around the smallest planet in our solar system. When flight operators fire its thrusters on Saturday, it will become only the second mission in history to orbit this little-known world.
paragraphs.zh: 在航行超過八年及六十億英里後，一艘歐洲與日本聯合研製的太空船終於抵達了水星。這項名為貝皮可倫坡號（BepiColombo）的任務正準備進入這顆太陽系最小行星的軌道。當飛行管制人員於週六啟動其推進器時，它將成為史上僅僅第二個繞行這個鮮為人知世界的任務。

paragraphs.en: Traveling to Mercury is extremely difficult because the planet is very close to the sun. The sun’s strong gravity pulls spacecraft toward it, forcing them to brake constantly so they do not fly past their target. The 1.6-billion-euro project hopes to discover how Mercury was formed, why it has a magnetic field, and what creates the frozen ice hidden inside its dark craters.
paragraphs.zh: 前往水星極其困難，因為這顆行星非常靠近太陽。太陽強大的重力會將太空船往其方向拉引，迫使它們必須不斷減速，才不會直接衝過目標。這項耗資十六億歐元的計畫希望能發現水星是如何形成的、它為何擁有磁場，以及是什麼構成了藏在其陰暗隕石坑內的冰凍冰層。

paragraphs.en: In early December, the spacecraft will separate into two distinct probes that will move into different polar orbits. Scientific research will officially begin in April of next year. The European probe will map the surface and investigate the planet's unusually large core, while the Japanese probe will study the magnetic field and the thin layer of gas surrounding the planet.
paragraphs.zh: 十二月初，這艘太空船將分離為兩個不同的探測器，分別進入不同的極地軌道。科學研究工作預計於明年四月正式展開。歐洲的探測器將繪製地表地圖並調查該行星異常巨大的核心，而日本的探測器則將研究磁場以及環繞該行星的稀薄氣體層。

paragraphs.en: Mercury is a world of extreme conditions. It rotates slowly, taking 58 Earth days to complete one turn, which leads to three months of daylight followed by three months of darkness. In addition, temperatures can reach 450 degrees Celsius during the day and plunge to minus 180 degrees at night.
paragraphs.zh: 水星是一個處於極端環境的世界。它的自轉十分緩慢，需要五十八個地球日才能完成一次自轉，這導致了長達三個月的白晝以及隨後三個月的黑夜。此外，白天的溫度可高達攝氏四百五十度，而夜晚則會驟降至零下一百八十度。

paragraphs.en: Scientists are eager to gather new information with advanced instruments over the next three years. However, the probes cannot return home when the mission concludes. According to Professor Emma Bunce from the University of Leicester, "Sadly, they are not coming back." Once they run out of fuel, the orbiters will fall and crash into the rocky surface.
paragraphs.zh: 科學家們渴望在未來的三年內，利用先進的儀器收集新的資訊。然而，當任務結束時，這些探測器將無法返回地球。誠如萊斯特大學（University of Leicester）的艾瑪．邦斯教授（Prof Emma Bunce）所言：「遺憾的是，它們回不來了。」一旦燃料耗盡，這些軌道探測器將會失去高度並撞毀在岩石表面上。

grammar.explain: 現在分詞片語「forcing...」在此作分詞構句，修飾前面的主要子句，表示引力拉扯所導致的自然結果。
grammar.example: The sun’s strong gravity pulls spacecraft toward it, forcing them to brake constantly so they do not fly past their target.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Adjective Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 「that」為關係代名詞，在此引導形容詞子句修飾先行詞「two distinct probes」，並在子句中作主詞。
grammar.example: In early December, the spacecraft will separate into two distinct probes that will move into different polar orbits.
grammar.focus: that will move into different polar orbits

grammar.point: 對等連接詞引導的對比子句 (Adversative Clause with While)
grammar.explain: 連接詞「while」在此表示對比，意為「而／然而」，用來呈現歐洲探測器與日本探測器各自負責的不同科研任務。
grammar.example: The European probe will map the surface and investigate the planet's unusually large core, while the Japanese probe will study the magnetic field and the thin layer of gas surrounding the planet.
grammar.focus: while the Japanese probe will study the magnetic field and the thin layer of gas surrounding the planet
